__1 N. of the people living round Gayā and the district inhabited by them. 
__2 N. of an Asura. 
__3 Wealth. 
__4 House, household, family. 
__5 Offspring, progeny. 
__6 The sky. 
__7 One's own place or abode. 
-या N. of a city in Behar which is a place of pilgrimage.
[गै भावे घञ्] Singing, a song; यथाविधानेन पठन् सामगायमविच्युतम् [[
a. Ved. Promoting domestic wealth; गयस्फानो अमीवहा [[

[गै-ण्वुल्] 
__1 A singer, musician; न नटा न विटा न गायकाः [[
a. Consisting in or connected with गायत्री; गर्गाद्यदुकुलाचार्याद्गायत्रं व्रतमास्थितौ [[

.]] 
-त्रम् A song or hymn; एतद्गायत्रं प्राणेषु प्रोतम् [[Ch.
__1 A Vedic metre of 24 syllables; गायत्री छन्दसामहम् [[

.]] 
__2 N. of a very sacred verse repeated by every Brāhmaṇa at his Sandhyā (morning and evening devotions) and on other occasions also. Great sins even are said to be expiated by a pious repetition of this verse, which is as follows:--तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात् [[

.]] 
__3 A number of mystical verses in Tantra literature. 
__4 N. of Durgā, [[

.]] 
-त्रम् A hymn composed and recited in the Gāyatrī metre. 
-Comp. 
-मन्त्रः prayers connected with the गायत्री. 
-वल्लभः an epithet of Śiva.
a. (-णी f.) One who sings hymns, especially of the Sāmaveda; गायन्ति त्वा गायत्रिणो [[
(नी f.) [गै-ल्युट्] A singer; गायनैश्च विरोविण्यो वादनैश्च तथापरैः । विरेजुर्विपुलास्तत्र सर्वरत्नसमन्विताः ॥ [[

]] v. l. 
-नम् 
__1 Singing a song. 
__2 Practising singing as a means of subsistence.
